breakdown.description: Both RAS and LES models are defined in `turbulenceProperties`. An OpenFOAM simulation cannot be both RAS and LES simultaneously; one must be chosen.
breakdown.reason: The Agent correctly identified that a simulation cannot be both RAS and LES. It resolved this by specifying a pure RANS approach (`Use a pure RANS approach only.`), setting the `simulationType` to `RAS`, and explicitly instructing to `Do not include an LES sub-dictionary in constant/turbulenceProperties.` This fully corrects the user's contradictory request.
